body: Source grounding lead from `docs/신청서.pdf` (17 pages): the application already specifies an event-driven, not always-on-model design. Upload: PPTX/PDF/notes -> slide_id/version + structured text/table/chart extraction, OCR only as fallback, optional upload-time VLM cache. Live: web viewer emits authoritative `{deck_id, slide_id, version, observed_at}` (UNKNOWN rather than guessed), streaming STT separates partial vs final; partial only primes search/captions, final + current slide creates the orchestration event. Retrieval triggers only on meaningful claims/questions/terms. External candidates require original-page evidence and primary-source preference; internal RAG is ACL-prefiltered lexical+dense with revision/anchor/hash metadata. Verification states: SUPPORTED (only state allowed on audience screen), UNCERTAIN, CONFLICTING, UNSUPPORTED; cards also become STALE on slide change or SUPERSEDED by better evidence. Coaching uses Korean syllables/min, articulation speed, silence ratio, persistence + cooldown; post-report recomputes from event history. MVP target: <=5 s after utterance, <=3 items, every item linked to original source. Key tension to preserve: page 10 also says presenter/team approval before display, so 'verified' and 'approved' are distinct gates.
